scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Nurul Huda Academy is now open.
Every class is live, online and one to one, for 30 minutes.

scenes.ur: جانچے پرکھے اساتذہ، خواتین اساتذہ بھی دستیاب
scenes.sub: Our Head of Academics is a Hafiza, and every teacher passes her recitation test.
After every class, you get a short report on your child's progress.
Your child's first class is free, with a level check.
Book your free trial at nurulhudaacademy.org
